lead: A table of contents for the page: clicking a link scrolls smoothly to its section, and while scrolling the current section is highlighted, with the indicator line following it. Links are real `<a href="#id">` elements, so when the target element is missing the browser's default behaviour applies.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Inside a scrolling element, given with `container`; without `container` it follows the window.
usage.placeholder: Section `#{id}`. Placeholder text that makes the container scroll: when this section reaches the top, the table of contents highlights its link.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.active: Active: `{active}` (when controlled it changes on click, not on scroll)

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles style these hooks in `anchor.css`.
styling.root: The root (`nav`): `data-direction`; `data-empty` when no link is highlighted; `data-ready` once the indicator is in place. The current link's position is written on the root as `--anchor-x` / `y` / `w` / `h` (pixels, unitless)
styling.ink: The indicator line that moves with the current link, positioned from the variables above
styling.list: The list (`data-level` is its depth) and each item
styling.link: A link; the current one has `data-active` and `aria-current=location`
